 RRB Group D scorecard 2026 out at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in; download link active till December 1
 RRB Group D scorecard 2026 out at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in; download link active till December 1
 Vishnukumar V | November 16, 2026 | 08:16 PM IST | 1 min read
 Candidates need their registration number and date of birth to check RRB Group D score card 2026 and normalised marks.
 RRB Group D scorecard 2026 out (Representative Image: Magnific) The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB Group D Scorecard 2026 today for candidates who appeared in the Level 1 Computer Based Test (CBT) under Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) 09/2025. Candidates can check their RRB Group D score card and normalised marks through the official regional websites using their registration number and date of birth.
 The RRB Group D score card 2026 link will remain available until December 1, 2026, at 11:55 pm. Candidates must enter their registration number and date of birth in DDMMYYYY format to access their marks.
 Earlier, the Railway Recruitment Boards declared the zone-wise RRB Group D result 2026 and cut-off marks on November 12, 2026. The examination was conducted from August 3 to 25, 2026.
 Also read UPSC ESE 2027 exam schedule out; prelims on January 31, admit card soon 
 How to download RRB Group D Scorecard 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their RRB Group D score card.
 Visit the official website rrb.indianrailways.gov.in
 Click the respective region link
 Find the link for RRB Group D score card under CEN 09/2025.
 Click on the RRB Group D score card download link.
 Enter the registration number and date of birth in DDMMYYYY format.
 Submit the login details.
 The RRB Group D score card will appear on the screen.
 Download and save the scorecard for future reference.
 Candidates can view their percentile scores and normalised marks by logging into the portal.
 Those who are shortlisted in the RRB Group D result 2026 will have to appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), followed by document verification and the medical examination, as applicable.
